ashley-marketing: Quick brief for launch week visuals — we need a focused "visual pulse" pack for the webinar + social + sales. Goal: clear, repeatable micro-explanations that sales can drop into decks. Deliverables: 1 hero slide (web + webinar banner), 1 one-page benchmark primer (editable), 6 explanation templates (icons + diagram slots), 18 social variants (3 sizes), and a sales-ready PNG deck pack. Outputs: Figma components, PNG/SVG exports, and one short loop GIF for the hero. Locales: en/de/fr. Can design pick this up? :zap:

rafa-design: Yep — we can. Two clarifying Qs: 1) Do we need editable data layers for the primer (csv or sparkline layer)? 2) Any constraints on copy length/CTA variants?

ashley-marketing: Good Qs. 1) Yes — make the primer editable: the sparkline should be vector with an overlay layer for data points (so sales can toggle). 2) CTAs: Register / See benchmark / Request demo. Keep headlines <= 12 words, body <= 25 words.

meera-creative: Style direction — lean, geometric icons with 1px stroke, soft corner radius on panels. For hero GIF, two frames: subtle token glow + slight upward motion. I'll mock the frames. Also propose an optional animated SVG teaser for the web hero.

rafa-design: Export spec proposal:
```
- Hero: 1600x900 PNG @2x, GIF 800x450 loop, Figma slide with speaker placeholder and Lottie-ready frames
- Primer: 1200x900 PNG + layered PDF (editable sparkline layer)
- Explanation templates (x6): 1080x1080 and 1200x628 PNGs, source SVG icons, optional small sequence diagram slot
- Social: 1200x628, 1080x1080, 820x312 exports; each with alternative CTA variants
- Sales deck pack: 16:9 PNG slides + one PPTX template using the components
- Filenames: pulse_<asset>_<topic>_<locale>_v1.<ext>
```
Sound right?

ashley-marketing: Yes. Naming good. Priority order: hero, primer, 3 explanation templates (cache, routing tiers, batching) then the remaining 3 (quantization, kv-cache, fallback). Social variants can map to the templates. Deadline: EOD next Thu (6 days).

rafa-design: Noted. Quick accessibility check: we should maintain contrast >=4.5:1 for body and ensure all icons have alt text in the Figma notes. I'll include an accessibility frame with passes.

meera-creative: For sparkline labeling, prefer annotations like "median latency" and "per-token cost" rather than raw numbers. We'll add a small footnote: "Results illustrative; varies by model and workload."

tom-solutions: Engineering notes: Eng-ML will do a 20-min terminology pass. Avoid percentages or claims like "50% faster" unless validated. For diagram slots, keep sequence diagrams to 3 steps max and annotate as "high-level." I'll schedule the review when the first mock is in.

alex-product: I'll provide the final copy by tomorrow noon. Copy guidance: benefit-first bullets, avoid absolutes. I'll add product-approved CTA text. Also request a tiny sales sticker: a 300x100 PNG that says "Benchmark inside" for quick deck insertion.

localebot: Localization note: we can support DE/FR. Please provide a localization spreadsheet with source copy in the Figma file and mark which CTAs require gendered variants. I'll add translators to the file once tagged.

rafa-design: Good. We'll structure the Figma file with a components page: color tokens, type scale (Redwood Sans), icon library, grid system, and localization notes. Fonts: Redwood Sans (headings), Redwood Sans Text (body), Redwood Mono (code). Max copy per template: headline 12 words, body 25 words.

meera-creative: Motion deliverables: GIF for social + MP4 hero teaser (640x360). We'll also include two Lottie frames for the web hero if product wants to embed.

ashley-marketing: Owners: Rafa - design lead; Meera - motion/creative; Alex - product copy; Tom - engineering reviewer; Ashley - campaign owner + final signoff. Please drop Figma frames in folder `visual-pulse/` and tag me.

rafa-design: I'll drop initial components and hero + primer first pass by EOD tomorrow. Label frames with TODOs for localization.

tom-solutions: Once mockups are live I'll run a quick 15m accuracy pass and ping eng-ml.

alex-product: Will post copy into the localization sheet and leave comments in Figma with suggested CTA variants.

meera-creative: I'll upload two motion frames and example GIF tonight.

ashley-marketing: Thanks all. One last ask: keep exports flattened for sales but attach source components. Sales team wants quick drag/drop images and a single PPTX pack. If any timeline slips, flag early. :rocket:

rafa-design: Understood. Tracking in Trello under "visual pulse sprint". Will follow naming conv `pulse_<asset>_<topic>_<locale>_v1.png`.

localebot: Added localization reminder: include english source strings in a single sheet, mark context comments for translators.

ashley-marketing: Great — see you tomorrow for the first pass. :sparkles:
